suites.title: Qualcomm AI Hub language inference
suites.description: Qualcomm AI Hub reports prompt and generation rates by configured context limit, compute unit, precision and runtime. Context is the configured limit. Vision-capable model entries measure language tokens only. Qualcomm’s projected device aliases are excluded. These records omit input lengths, peak memory and individual job IDs.
